text:
Carla M: heads up — canary for Dedicated 3.7.4 is showing a big p95 jump after the merge that went out at 03:00 UTC. rollout paused.
Omar P: ugh — metrics? which customers affected?
Carla M: only on dedicated pools with nvlink-enabled nodes so far. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~1.2s on generate_v2 route. KV cache miss_rate went from 0.02 -> 0.43.
SRE Bot: [alert] canary-p95 > 800ms on dedicated-canary-3 (service: runtime/dedicated)
Lee W: any obvious error logs or OOMs?
Carla M: no OOM. profiler shows much higher mem churn and many cache evictions around the time of the spike. suspect batching heuristic change + kernel hint mismatch.
Omar P: which change touched batching? I remember a late PR touching latency-aware batching windows.
Juniper: PR #4521 bumped batch_time_threshold from 8ms -> 20ms and added new 'fused_matmul_v2' hint mapping for seq_len > 1024.
Lee W: that could explain it — longer batching window means more heavy-seq requests get merged, bigger temporary KV footprint, evictions. fused_matmul_v2 uses a different memory layout which increases KV cache residency.
Carla M: snapshot of relevant metrics (canary vs baseline):
```
p95_generate_v2: baseline=120ms canary=1240ms
kv_cache.hit_rate: baseline=0.98 canary=0.57
kv_cache.evictions_per_min: baseline=4 canary=58
batch_window_ms: baseline=8 canary=20
kernel_selector: majority=fused_matmul_v2 (canary) vs fused_matmul_v1 (baseline)
```
Omar P: CI perf tests also failed on the merge, but signal was subtle and got masked by flakiness. I saw a perf reg diff in the nightly bench run: longseq throughput -22%.
DevEx Bot: link to CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/7890 diff shows p95 regressions on dedicated matrices.
Carla M: bisecting locally now. early results point at the batch_time_threshold change + kernel hint coupling in selector.
Lee W: can we hotpatch selector to ignore the new kernel hint for dedicated pools? That would be lower risk than full revert.
Juniper: quick test: set env REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT_OVERRIDE=baseline and flip enable_latency_aware_batching=false on canary.
Carla M: tried the override on one canary shard — p95 dropped to ~150ms and kv evictions returned to baseline within 30s.
Omar P: nice. do we want to roll that as a temporary mitigation and continue bisect+fix?
Lee W: yes, do mitigation and then revert the PR until we can rework memory heuristics. The PR introduced two coupled changes; they need to be split and validated separately.
Carla M: action items: 1) Juniper will push kernel hint override to all canary shards (hotpatch), 2) Omar will finish bisect and confirm exact commit(s), 3) I will open a rollback PR for #4521 if bisect confirms.
Juniper: pushing hotpatch now: `kubectl -n runtime set env deployment/dedicated-canary REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT_OVERRIDE=baseline`
SRE Bot: deploy succeeded on 3/3 canary replicas, monitoring p95.
Carla M: after hotpatch p95 across canary: 140ms / kv_cache.hit_rate ~0.97. Holding rollout until rollback PR lands.
Omar P: bisect result — culprit commit: 7a9c3f8 (split batching window change bundled with kernel hint). I'll prepare a revert for just the batching window part.
Lee W: prefer reverting both at once to be safe; we can reintroduce kernel hint in a later, isolated PR with memory footprint tests.
Carla M: agreed. Juniper will keep the override in place until revert is merged + deployed. after that we'll run dedicated stress tests and longseq benches.
DevEx Bot: noted slack action: #action Juniper apply hotpatch, #action Omar finish bisect, #action Carla open revert PR.
Juniper: hotpatch will remain until rollback is confirmed in prod. tagging @oncall if ETA > 2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
SRE Bot: canary hold is in place; rollout remains paused for Dedicated 3.7.4. SLA risk flagged for any customer traffic on dedicated pools until fix.
Carla M: thanks all — will follow up with a post-mortem once rollback and validation complete.
Omar P: I'll also add a CI perf guard on the nightly bench to block merges with >10% longseq throughput regressions for dedicated profiles.
Lee W: and add a mem-footprint test to the kernel selection unit tests so future kernel hints are validated against KV cache impact.
Carla M: good plan. closing thread when rollback merged. :white_check_mark:
